games.description: Co-op with APL through an underwater facility, conserving ammunition while hacking doors and investigating its experiments. The route expands beyond the metro, ending in a lethal juggernaut encounter and discovery that the co-op run cannot be reloaded.
games.title: Chasmal Fear

games.description: A brief solo sampler precedes the full co-op return with APL. They work through the dream’s keys, basketball shots, picture puzzles, supermarket and laptop videos before reaching the credits.
games.title: KunKun dream Startles the Soul

games.description: Sark investigates strange activity at a rural home, discovers evidence of abductions and explores the aliens’ ship.
games.title: The Greys: Human Abductions

games.description: Sark follows a schoolchild’s increasingly frightening encounters at a crossing, calls the station and reaches an ambiguous return to the opening.
games.title: The Railroad Crossing

games.description: Sark and APL join a survival lobby after a plane crash, discover that they cannot see each other in the world and abandon the broken multiplayer attempt.
games.title: The Seekers: Survival
